description: Source code for mod_authn_pam, a PAM backend module for lighttpd HTTP authentication, including configuration handling, PAM integration, and plugin initialization.

methods.name: mod_authn_pam_init
methods.description: Initializes the PAM authentication backend and registers it.

methods.name: mod_authn_pam_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges individual configuration plugin values into the plugin configuration.

methods.name: mod_authn_pam_merge_config
methods.description: Merges multiple configuration plugin values into the plugin configuration.

methods.name: mod_authn_pam_patch_config
methods.description: Applies configuration settings to the current request context.

methods.name: mod_authn_pam_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the plugin.

methods.name: mod_authn_pam_fn_conv
methods.description: Converts PAM messages to responses, providing the password when prompted.

methods.name: mod_authn_pam_query
methods.description: Performs PAM authentication for a given username and password.

methods.name: mod_authn_pam_basic
methods.description: Handles basic authentication requests, invoking PAM and checking rules.

methods.name: mod_authn_pam_plugin_init
methods.description: Exports plugin initialization function for lighttpd.
